name: Email operations
description: Inbound mail: threading, quoted context, the greeting and the signature, and the one ask the sender made.
overview: What the subject demands when the artifact is a mail thread: respect the thread, quote what you answer, and answer the ask the sender actually made.
invariants: Treat the thread as context: an answer that ignores what was already said reopens the question.
Quote the sentence you answer when the thread carries more than one question.
Keep the greeting and the signature proportional to the thread's own register.
prefer: Put the answer first and the explanation after it.
Preserve the sender's identifiers (order reference, ticket id) verbatim.
Close with the one action the sender should take next, if any.
avoid: Do not restate the whole thread; quote only the part you answer.
Do not change the subject line of a thread you are replying into.
